identity: printer_id is the exact Agent execution printer ID, also stored as the Gateway printers.id; it is not a name, queue label or another inventory identifier
numericRules: All values must be finite JSON numbers. Dot counts and DPI are integers; millimetres are strictly positive and may be fractional. Numeric strings, null, booleans, arrays and coercion are forbidden. Unknown optional measurements are omitted.
physicalConsistency: When paper, DPI and printable measurements are known on an axis, printable dots plus any known offset must fit paper_mm * axis_dpi / 25.4 within one device pixel. Missing offsets are not reported as zero.
provenance: windows_driver/ipp require validation observed; validated_profile requires configured. observed_at is UTC RFC3339. Refreshing only observed_at does not change capability identity or invalidate approval/jobs.
fingerprint: config_fingerprint is lowercase SHA256 hex generated by the Agent over canonical execution binding, protocol, geometry, explicit raster command and relevant driver/form/media configuration. It excludes observation time, status, secrets and URI credentials. Gateway validates identity and desired-state convergence; Agent verifies the fingerprint against current execution configuration immediately before output.

consumers.preRenderedRaster: Verified printable_width_dots, explicit raster_command gs_v_0, and matching image geometry_fingerprint; physical millimetres and DPI are not invented or required for already-rendered pixels.
consumers.physicalReceipt: JPEG-to-PDF/driver and IPP page media require actual paper_width_mm, dpi_x, dpi_y and printable_width_dots. Unknown paper dimensions must not be manufactured from printable pixels.
consumers.ordinaryPdf: Document transports retain PDF capability and measure/validate the selected driver or IPP media at execution. A missing cached geometry does not disable ordinary document printing.
consumers.rasterTypography: Verified printable_width_dots, dpi_x and dpi_y determine logical CSS width printable_width_dots * 96 / dpi_x; device-pixel output uses actual x/y resolution. Physical paper width may be unknown for direct ESC/POS output; if provided it must agree with printable dimensions.

migration: Legacy max_paper_width is not consumed by Gateway/Odoo as measured geometry. The Agent may deliberately validate an explicit dot-valued legacy configuration into a configured profile; values at or below 128 are ambiguous and must not be guessed as mm or dots. Nominal 58/80 mm roll labels never imply 384/512/576 dots.
invalidation: A manager transport/protocol/profile change clears the observed geometry; until desired state is both applied and observed, the Gateway does not expose geometry or admit an image. A submitted image's geometry_fingerprint must match the current validated geometry. Native execution rechecks after driver/media/destination changes.
